did we do this?
**Keep floor identity and raster scroll in one consistent observation.**

`CaptureLogicTick` takes the floor pair and dungeon address from live guest RAM at tick time. The raster scroll comes from an earlier latched scanline. If the guest changes floors between those reads, the tick can label the last raster of floor A as floor B. `ResolveRasterCamera` accepts any scroll within 24 pixels of the live camera and does not check floor identity. Nearby camera positions therefore pass, and the midpoint can blend two real frames from different floors.

The capture also runs before the producer join. The frontend contract says guest simulation is touched only after the join, but this block reads guest RAM while the producer can still run scheduler rounds. The stale window is wider than the scroll-to-floor gap.

Require that the floor identity and the raster scroll come from one consistent guest observation. Require that guest RAM is not read while the producer can run. Reject or reset the tick when the floor identity disagrees with the raster.
